subproblems.baseline: Single top-down scaling from IEA 415 TWh with a fixed utilization factor.
subproblems.primary_model: Bottom-up stock model: E_full = (N_servers*P_server + N_AI*P_AI*host_factor)*storage_network_factor*8760*PUE; E_avg = E_full * capacity_factor; Monte-Carlo over parameter ranges; validated against IEA/Masanet anchors.
subproblems.fallback_model: Pure top-down anchor scaling with growth rates if bottom-up components are not defensible.

rejected.model: Training a neural net on sparse energy history
rejected.reason: 9 annual anchor points cannot support a statistical learner; physically meaningless extrapolation.
global FLOPs demand data unavailable at required granularity; would add unverifiable assumptions.

validation_plan: Check E_avg_2024 range brackets IEA 415 TWh

subproblems.baseline: Global-average grid CI (single number) x E_avg.
subproblems.primary_model: Regional disaggregation: C = sum_r E_r * CI_r, CI_r from Ember fuel mix and fuel-level EFs; E_r from regional DC distribution; Monte-Carlo.
subproblems.fallback_model: World CI x E_avg if regional distribution data collapses.

rejected.reason: marginal emission datasets not public at global coverage; would sacrifice reproducibility.

validation_plan: MC median C_2024 in plausible band

subproblems.baseline: Single IEA extrapolation (945 TWh, one path).
subproblems.primary_model: Three growth scenarios (conservative 8% CAGR / IEA-anchored baseline / Goldman-anchored high) x three grid-decay scenarios (0.5/2/4% per year); emissions coupled via C=E*CI; report 2030 bounds as scenario envelope + MC spread.
subproblems.fallback_model: ARIMA on anchor series (only if scenario envelope rejected).

rejected.reason: parameter-fragile on 4-5 anchor points; less transparent than anchored scenarios.

subproblems.baseline: Linear interpolation of CI between current mix and 100% clean.
subproblems.primary_model: Mix renormalization sweep: replace fossil share s with clean share renormalized from Ember world mix; CI(s)=sum share_f(s)*EF_f; reduction vs frozen 2024 baseline; coal-first displacement variant.

rejected.reason: no plant-level fleet data at global scale; reproducibility loss without added insight.

validation_plan: residual at 100% clean matches lifecycle EFs

subproblems.primary_model: W(t)=E_IT(t)*WUE; WUE triangular(0.2,1.8,5.2) from literature; scarcity weighting via stressed-region share; scenario table 2024-2030.

rejected.reason: willingness: e-waste data (flows, lifetimes) far noisier than WUE; water chosen for tight energy coupling and data quality - consistent with excellent-paper precedent (team 16226).

subproblems.primary_model: Carbon-aware scheduling lever: C_eff = E*(1-f_shift*delta_CI)*CI_grid with f_shift~U(0.3,0.6), delta_CI~U(0.10,0.20); quantified delta-Mt for 2030 scenarios; plus 24/7 CFE lever mapped to Q4 curve; letter to UN.
subproblems.fallback_model: Qualitative recommendation list only (if lever parameters not defensible).

rejected.reason: quantitative reuse potential varies by siting; treated qualitatively.

selection_evidence: literature on flexible AI workloads and diurnal CI
